access_log_enabled.description: Enable or disable writing access logs.

access_log_path.description: Path to the access log file (only used if access logging is enabled).

client_max_body_size.description: Maximum allowed size (in bytes) of the HTTP request body (e.g., for bulk imports).

client_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds for client connections.

db_path.description: Directory where Groonga databases are stored.

default_db.description: Path to the database file used when no database is specified in the request path.

extra_options.description: Arbitrary Groonga core configuration options (e.g., token_filters, normalizers). Each key-value pair is written as 'key value' in the config.

items.description: Option value for the named Groonga configuration parameter.

gzip_enabled.description: Enable response compression with gzip for supported clients.

gzip_types.description: MIME types eligible for gzip compression (only used if gzip is enabled).

listen_address.description: IP address the server binds to (e.g., 127.0.0.1 for localhost only, 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces).

listen_port.description: TCP port on which the HTTP server listens for incoming requests.

log_level.description: Minimum log level; messages at this level and above are logged.

log_path.description: Path to the main log file (stderr if omitted or empty).

maintenance_message.default: Server under maintenance. Please try again later.
maintenance_message.description: Plain-text message returned when maintenance mode is active.

maintenance_mode_enabled.description: If enabled, the server returns HTTP 503 with the custom message below.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

pid_file.description: Absolute path to the file where the server writes its process ID.

server_name.description: Server name used for Host header validation in HTTP/1.1; leave empty to disable.

ssl_certificate_key_path.description: Path to the TLS private key file (only used if SSL is enabled).

ssl_certificate_path.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (only used if SSL is enabled).

worker_processes.description: Number of worker processes to spawn (use CPU core count for optimal throughput).
